map.电子湮灭光子能量计算器 使用指南: Electron Annihilation Photon Energy Calculator User Guide
map.基于电子-正电子湮灭产生两个 511 keV 光子的物理事实，计算或说明湮灭光子: Based on the physics fact that electron-positron annihilation produces two 511 keV photons, this computes or explains the annihilation photon energy (corresponding to the electron rest mass of 0.511 MeV). Used for PET imaging and demonstrations of positron annihilation principles.
map.电子对湮灭产生两个 511 keV 光子。: Electron annihilation produces two 511 keV photons.
map.e⁺e⁻ 湮灭各释放 E = mₑc² ≈ 511 keV 光子。: Each e+ e- annihilation releases a photon of E = m_e c^2 = about 511 keV.
map.对比不同粒子湮灭能量。: Compare annihilation energies of different particles.
map.：E = mₑc² / e / 1000 = 511 keV；正负电子湮灭产生两: E = m_e c^2 / e / 1000 = 511 keV; electron-positron annihilation produces two 511 keV back-to-back gamma photons.
map.：总静能 2×511=1022 keV 转为两光子动能（各 511 keV，动量: The total rest energy 2 x 511 = 1022 keV converts into the kinetic energy of two photons (511 keV each), with momentum conserved in opposite directions.

map.单光子无法同时满足能量与动量守恒，两光子背向发射可同时守恒。: A single photon cannot satisfy energy and momentum conservation at once, while two photons emitted back to back can conserve both simultaneously.
map.电子静质量 9.11e-31 kg 乘 c² 得约 8.19e-14 J，换算为: The electron rest mass of 9.11e-31 kg times c^2 gives about 8.19e-14 J, which converts to 511 keV.
